create_unique_rule: create a UniqueRule to check that a given relation is unique for each node in the graph
check_unique_rule: check a graph with UniqueRule to validate no node has more than one outgoing edge of a type
create_symmetry_inference: create a SymmetryInference rule to auto-generate reverse edges so AB relations match BA relations
infer_symmetry: infer missing symmetric edges in a graph using SymmetryInference and add them with supporting evidence
create_triangle_inference: create a TriangleInference rule to derive new BC relations from existing AB and AC relations in a graph
